name: エレガントブラウン
css: body { overflow: hidden !important; }

.roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F5E6D3, #E8D5C4); border-radius: 50%; padding: 25px; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.3), 0 0 0 1px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.2), inset 0 0 50px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); margin: 0 !important; }

.gold-ring { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 500px; height: 500px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #D4AF37; opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5; animation: ringGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes ringGlow { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3); } 50% { opacity: 0.8; box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5); } }
#roulette-svg-target { border-radius: 50%; }
/* --- Pointer (修正: 位置を下げて調整) --- */

.pointer { position: absolute; top: 35px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 25; width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 15px solid transparent; border-right: 15px solid transparent; border-top: 40px solid #D4AF37; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.8)); }

.pointer::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -45px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 18px; height: 18px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #FAF0E6, #D4AF37); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.5), inset 0 2px 5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); border: 2px solid #B8956A; }

.center-circle { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 120px; height: 120px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #FAF0E6, #E8D5C4); border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #B8956A; box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.3), inset 0 3px 15px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5), inset 0 -3px 10px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.1); z-index: 30; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.center-ornament { width: 35px; height: 35px; margin-bottom: 6px; position: relative; }

.center-ornament::before { content: ''; position: absolute; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #B8956A, transparent); width: 35px; height: 2px; top: 50%; left: 0; transform: translateY(-50%); }

.center-ornament::after { content: ''; position: absolute; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #B8956A, transparent); width: 2px; height: 35px; left: 50%; top: 0; transform: translateX(-50%); }

.center-diamond { position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FAF0E6, #D4AF37); top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.6); animation: diamondPulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes diamondPulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.6); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.9); } }
.center-text { font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; color: #8B7355; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'Georgia', serif; }
.decorative-line { position: absolute; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #D4AF37 20%, #D4AF37 80%, transparent); width: 250px; opacity: 0.6; z-index: 10; }
.line-top { top: 60px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.line-bottom { top: 540px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 35; }
.corner-ornament { position: absolute; width: 60px; height: 60px; border: 2px solid #D4AF37; opacity: 0.4; z-index: 8; }
.corner-tl { top: 30px; left: 30px; border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-radius: 8px 0 0 0; }
.corner-tr { top: 30px; right: 30px; border-left: none; border-bottom: none; border-radius: 0 8px 0 0; }
.corner-bl { bottom: 30px; left: 30px; border-right: none; border-top: none; border-radius: 0 0 0 8px; }
.corner-br { bottom: 30px; right: 30px; border-left: none; border-top: none; border-radius: 0 0 8px 0; }

#spinBtn { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 240px; height: 70px; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #5A4A3A; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FAF0E6, #E8D5C4); border: 3px solid #B8956A; border-radius: 50px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); transition: all 0.3s; letter-spacing: 5px; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'Georgia', serif; position: absolute; top: 570px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
#spinBtn::before { content: '◆'; position: absolute; left: 25px; color: #D4AF37; font-size: 16px; animation: ornamentShine 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
#spinBtn::after { content: '◆'; position: absolute; right: 25px; color: #D4AF37; font-size: 16px; animation: ornamentShine 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes ornamentShine { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; } 50% { opacity: 1; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.8); } }

#spinBtn:hover { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFFFF, #FAF0E6); }
#spinBtn:active { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.2); }
/* --- Result (修正: 視認性向上のため背景と濃い文字色を追加) --- */

#result { font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; color: #3d2b1f; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-family: 'Georgia', serif; position: absolute; top: 650px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: auto; min-width: 300px; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 2px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); padding: 10px 30px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #B8956A; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(245, 230, 211, 0.95) !important; border: 2px solid #B8956A !important; border-radius: 8px !important; color: #5A4A3A !important; padding: 10px !important; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.2) !important; }
